limitations: Authored static layouts, not gameplay screenshots or assertions of current server rotation.
No native game/server/client/compiler, constructors, spawned objects, runtime lighting, smoothing, animation, randomization or lower-z view compositing.
Editor helpers and source-declared positive invisibility are omitted with source evidence. Missing source appearances are diagnostics, never substituted sprites.
All19broader diagnostic maps remain separate; this directory contains only the six clean map sources.
Task-local renderer is not included in this asset directory, so these files alone do not reproduce the pipeline. DMM, dependency and appearance hashes identify verified inputs.
